disease_label_per_paper: Acute promyelocytic leukemia presenting as bilateral acute limb ischemia and ST elevation myocardial infarction
presentation_summary: 71-year-old man presented with two days of bilateral lower-extremity pain and cold sensation.
Exam showed cold lower limbs and absent dorsalis pedis/posterior tibial pulses bilaterally.
Doppler and CTA showed occluded superficial femoral and popliteal arterial stent grafts bilaterally.
Initial labs showed thrombocytopenia, 30% peripheral blasts with APL morphology, low fibrinogen, high D-dimer, and prolonged INR.
Hospital course was complicated by RCA in-stent thrombosis causing STEMI and death.

risk_context.source_text_value: prior RCA PCI, PAD with bilateral superficial femoral artery stenting
bilateral acute limb ischemia before chemotherapy exposure
